entities.summary: Alex T. Atamanenko is a Canadian politician who served as the member of Parliament (MP) for British Columbia Southern Interior from 2006 to 2015. A member of the New Democratic Party (NDP), Atamanenko was first elected in the 2006 federal election and retired in 2015. He worked as a teacher before entering politics.
